title: 3 BOXES OF RED GLAZED ENGLISH ...
reason: Large collection of vintage English stoneware jugs and pots that may total $100 or more, maker unconfirmed; check bases for Doulton, Denby or Langley marks.
findings: About 35 pieces of English-style brown salt-glaze stoneware: two lidded coffee pots (one with a buff sanded band, one dark brown), graduated jugs in at least five sizes with sand-textured bands and impressed bead or rope borders, small cream jugs and jars, and five loose lids (one pierced with six holes). The look is in the Denby, Doulton Lambeth or Langley style, but no backstamp, impressed mark or base is shown in any of the 5 photos, so the maker is not established. The quantity and graduated sets are the appeal; individual pieces are modest.
condition: Some rim wear and glaze flecks visible, no cracks obvious in the photos; lids look loose and may not belong to the jugs; bases not photographed.
rescore_note: About 35 pieces of vintage English brown salt-glaze jugs, coffee pots and lids in graduated sizes, Denby or Doulton style but no maker's mark seen and bases not shown; a decent collection of individually modest pieces with likely odd lids, about the $80-200 band. No comps seen, judgement only.
